content.title: About
content.content: Cream “Half and Half” is a blend of equal parts cream and milk (1:1). It has a delicate buttery flavor, a light texture, and is suitable for coffee drinks, sauces, desserts, and general cooking.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The combination of cream and milk gives a milder taste than straight cream.
It is commonly used in coffee beverages to create a creamy foam without extra whipping.
In some countries “half and half” is classified as a distinct dairy product with its own food‑code.
Typical fat content is about 10‑12 %, making it lighter than pure cream.
It is packaged in cartons or plastic containers that are easy to store and transport.

items.title: Calcium source
items.content: Both cream and milk provide calcium, essential for bone and teeth health.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Contains riboflavin (B2) and vitamin B12, which support energy metabolism.

items.title: Protein
items.content: Offers a modest amount of high‑quality dairy protein useful for tissue repair.

items.title: Moderate fat content
items.content: Compared with straight cream, it has lower fat, which can fit better into a balanced diet.

items.title: Easy digestion
items.content: The milk component can make it easier to digest for some people than pure cream.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: Contains lactose; those who are intolerant should choose lactose‑free alternatives.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: People allergic to casein or whey may react to this product.

items.title: Fat content
items.content: Although lower than pure cream, it still contains moderate fat; portion control is advised.

items.title: Storage
items.content: If not stored properly, it can develop off‑flavors quickly after opening.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Half‑and‑half cream is ideal for coffee, latte, cappuccino, sauces, soups, casseroles, desserts, and as a base for ice cream or creamy fillings.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at 1‑4 °C in its original container. Once opened, use within 5‑7 days. Discard if it develops a sour smell or changes color.
